## `Agents` {#server-agents}

What an agent's changes over MCP may do without a person (plan §8.5).

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_apply` | list of [`ChangeClassName`](#server-changeclassname) | `["safe"]` | Change classes an agent's `apply_change` applies directly; anything else waits for approval. |


## `AuthSettings` {#server-authsettings}

The environment variables holding the access tokens (plan §9). A level whose variable is unset or empty is open; the admin token is good for every level. Read when the server starts.

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `admin_token_env` | string | `TIDEPOOL_ADMIN_TOKEN` | Changing the config, approving changes. |
| `ingest_token_env` | string | `TIDEPOOL_INGEST_TOKEN` | Writing and deleting rows. |
| `read_token_env` | string | `TIDEPOOL_READ_TOKEN` | Reading data, the model and dashboards. |


## `Writeback` {#server-writeback}

Write-back of applied changes (plan §8.1).

| key | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Write applied changes to the config files, so the directory always holds what the server runs. |
| `git_commit` | boolean | `true` | Commit them, when the config directory is in a git repository. |


## `Durability` {#server-durability}

| value | description |
| --- | --- |
| `fsync` | Acknowledge ingest after the write-ahead log is fsynced. |
| `async` | Acknowledge before the fsync: faster, and a crash can lose the last moments of acknowledged data. |


## `Duration` {#server-duration}

A duration with a unit: ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. 200ms, 730d).

Type: string.


## `MemorySize` {#server-memorysize}

A share of system memory (75%) or a size (8GiB).

Type: string.


## `ChangeClassName` {#server-changeclassname}

A plan's change class, as written in `tidepool.yaml`.

Type: `safe` · `rebuild` · `destructive`.
